description:
• About our brand and products:

VisionBoard.Shop is a purpose-driven brand focused on helping people turn their goals into clear, actionable visions.
Our all-in-one Vision Board Kits are designed for simplicity and impact — no printing, no extra tools, no hassle. Everything needed to create a powerful vision board for 2026 comes in one beautifully designed set.

• What makes us different:

Unlike traditional vision boards that require printing photos, buying glue, boards, or planning each step separately, our kits remove all friction.
We offer:

  • An all-in-one, ready-to-use experience

  • Clean, aesthetic designs made for modern lifestyles

  • A product that stays visible on desks or walls, keeping goals top-of-mind every day

  • A strong emotional connection focused on mindset, clarity, and intentional living

Our product is not just stationery — it’s a mindset tool.

• How affiliates can earn:

Affiliates earn a percentage commission on every successful sale made through their unique affiliate link or coupon code.
There is no limit to how much you can earn. The more you inspire and convert, the more you earn.

Commissions are tracked automatically, and partners are rewarded for every purchase they generate.

• How to promote us:

Affiliates can promote VisionBoard.Shop through:

  • TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts

  • Stories, posts, or voice-over content

  • Vision-focused, mindset, productivity, or lifestyle content

  • Personal goal-setting journeys or “prepare for 2026” themes

You are free to create content in your own authentic style. We encourage storytelling, personal experience, and creativity over scripted ads.

• Other information:

  • Affiliates receive a unique tracking link and optional discount code

  • Content may be reposted or used for paid ads with prior approval

  • This is a long-term partnership opportunity, not a one-time promotion

  • We value quality, authenticity, and alignment over follower count

If you inspire people, we’d love to work with you.
payout_period: 1st of each month or Quarterly on the 15th for payout timing.
